body:
Pass 30. Reviewed the scale gate before it runs for record. Harness is good - isolated worker, real RSS, proper thresholds, dense metric, explicit policy.

The fixture is statistically degenerate though, filed as bd-01KZXWPKT4XPSB55PB5RBSAZRT. On the exact geometry: 52416 voxels and supports of median 33, but observations=32 with 2 design columns gives 30 residual df, and 3 partitions under exclude_evaluation leaves ONE training run per edge. So 83.9% of supports have k > df - the local covariance is singular before shrinkage - and 99.9% exceed df/2. shrinkage_precision(0.2) is supplying the estimate rather than regularizing one.

Timing and memory stay valid as linear-algebra cost, but Epic 8 is about establishing the actual supported regime, and as configured it would certify dense local metrics at brain scale from a fixture where no searchlight can estimate one. It is also the exact data-starved corner that gave the largest metric bias in your Epic 7 study.

Cheap fix: observations 32 -> 200 (198 df), or partitions 3 -> 6 (120 df, df/k ~ 3.6). Raising observations costs simulation time only, not gate runtime. Worth emitting the realised df-to-support ratio in the output too.

Also still open: bd-01KZXW5MFZGEXVJ3CMKMGBGFZX, the MC test is still replications=64 against SEs pinned at 120 - 1% headroom on the variance gate.
